defects.title: A flux vector of zeros gives NaN widths
defects.trigger: map.rxnName = {'R1'; 'R2'} (other documented map fields filled), model.rxns = {'R1'; 'R2'}, fbaSolution.v = [0; 0]; map = addFluxFBAdirectionAndColor(map, model, fbaSolution)
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: map.rxnWidth = {NaN; NaN} (line 53 computes 0/0, no band of lines 56-61 matches NaN, line 74 stores it)
defects.expected: width 1 for every reaction without flux (lines 61 and 72 give 1 for a ratio below 1e-3 and for a reaction not in the model)

defects.title: A flux of exactly 1e-3 of the largest flux keeps width 0.001
defects.trigger: the map and model above with fbaSolution.v = [1e-3; 1]
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: map.rxnWidth = {0.0010; 8}: the bands of lines 60-61 are > 1e-3 and < 1e-3
defects.expected: a band width (1 or 3) for R1

notes: independent review T027/T028: both findings reproduced in MATLAB R2025a in this function (the wave 24 entries had been observed through the same computation in addFluxFBA). Regraded limitation -> wrong-result (zero flux vector, a valid n x 1 flux vector, gives NaN widths; l.61/l.72 show the intent of width 1, and the sibling addFluxWidthAndColor guards division by zero) and cosmetic -> wrong-result (ratio exactly 1e-3 keeps the raw value 0.001, not a band width); consistent with the same two entries in testAddFluxFBA.m, already wrong-result. Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: map.rxnName={'R1';'R2'}; map.rxnBaseReactantAlias={{'a'};{'b'}}; map.rxnReactantAlias={cell(0,1);cell(0,1)}; map.rxnBaseProductAlias={{'b'};{'c'}}; map.rxnProductAlias={cell(0,1);cell(0,1)}; map.rxnWidth={1;1}; map.rxnColor={'X';'X'}; map.molAlias={'a';'b';'c'}; map.molColor={'X';'X';'X'}; model.rxns={'R1';'R2'}; s.v=[0;0]; m=addFluxFBAdirectionAndColor(map,model,s); m.rxnWidth  % {NaN;NaN}; s.v=[1e-3;1] -> {0.0010;8}. Reach: data-dependent (an all-zero flux vector, or a reaction whose |v| is exactly 1e-3 of max|v|), not a recognisable call form, so every call reaches it; src/ callers: none (grep -w over src/ finds only the file itself). Coverage: quarantine layout, all 57 executable lines exempt.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027; read l.52-61: abs(v)/max(abs(v)) is 0/0 for a zero flux vector, and a ratio of exactly 1e-3 matches no band; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

notes: independent review T027/T028: dangling-modifier finding reproduced in MATLAB R2025a (map.sID/map.sAlias from getMapMatrices hold reactants and products only, so getCorrespondingRows(...,'exclusive') at l.62/65 sees s5/sa5 used by R5 alone). The writer's modifier-only entry regraded limitation -> wrong-result (contradicts the evident intent of l.37-38) and re-observed (R2025a: R1 removal leaves s5/sa5). Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: write the test's toy map (wave 13 version, git history) with a fourth reaction re4 'R5': base reactant s5/sa5 -> s6/sa6 (species F) added; removeCDReactions(f,{'R5'}); [~,m]=transformXML2Map(subset) -> m.specID {'s1';'s2';'s3';'s4'}, m.rxnModAlias{1} {'sa5'}, the file has no species s5 or alias sa5. Reach: the defects depend on the map's content (a modifier species shared with or confined to removed reactions), not on a call form, so every call reaches them; src/ callers: none (grep -w over src/ finds only the file itself). Coverage: quarantine layout, all 26 executable lines exempt.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027; read l.37-38 and 62-75: species are removed when all their sID/sAlias reactions go, modifiers are not in sID, so a species still catalysing a kept reaction is deleted, against the comment 'delete isolated species'; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: Every '~' of the file name is replaced by the home folder
defects.trigger: a file name starting with '~' that contains another '~'

notes: independent review T027/T028: all three findings reproduced in MATLAB R2025a. 'Map information can be added or changed but not removed' (limitation) split into two wrong-result entries (reversibility 'true' not written, l.162-164; emptied notes/compartment alias kept, l.79-81, 99-101, 281-283); the l.108-109/126-127 entry regraded limitation -> wrong-result (handling code never reached; a dangling speciesReference is written). Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: write a 4-species, 3-reaction CellDesigner map with reversible="false" (as the wave 11 test did, git history); [x,m]=transformXML2Map(f); m.rxnReversibility{1}='true'; transformMap2XML(x,m,out); [~,m2]=transformXML2Map(out); m2.rxnReversibility{1}  % 'false'. Reach: confined to maps whose rxnReversibility is changed to 'true', whose notes or molecule compartment aliases are emptied, or whose molecule aliases are reduced relative to xmlStruct (e.g. the output of transformToReversibleMap, or of an alias-removing edit). The five src/ callers (changeMapMetIDToName, visualizeFluxFromFile, visualizeFluxTimeseriesFromFile, visualizeReconstructionsOnMap, visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence) read the map with transformXML2Map and change only specName, rxnColor, rxnWidth and molColor (via addFluxFromFileWidthAndColor, addFluxWidthAndColor, changeRxnColorAndWidth, addColourNode, unifyMetabolicMapCD) before writing, so by reading none uses a triggering form; the lead decides whether the seed is transformMap2XML only. Coverage: quarantine layout, all 145 executable lines exempt.
confirmed_by: lead (review T027; read l.162-164: only 'false' is ever written to reversible, so a documented 'true' is lost; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: Reaction colours written in lower case are not counted as present
defects.trigger: a map in the folder whose present reactions have line colour 'ffff4500' (lower case, as CellDesigner writes colours)
defects.observed: R2025a 2026-11-17: presence [false false false false] for a map with R1, R2 in ffff4500
defects.expected: reactions of that colour counted as present (hex colour codes are case-insensitive)

notes: independent review T027/T028: all three findings reproduced in MATLAB R2025a. The l.150 index error with a custom scheme is regraded limitation -> error (a documented option that fails when used; the header documents the row format and an example list without requiring a final 0 row). The second-run behaviour, hidden by the wave 13 test deleting the heatmap before its second call, is wrong-result by the severity rule (the documented output is written into the input folder and every *.xml there is read as a map, so the documented normalisation is wrong on a re-run). The lower-case colour entry is regraded limitation -> wrong-result: the CellDesigner files of tutorials/visualization/metabolicCartography/data use lower-case codes (e.g. 'ff000000'). Test converted to the quarantine layout. Reproduction: four maps as in the wave 13 test (git history); visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence(md,{1,'aaaaaa',10;0.5,'bbbbbb',5},1) -> index error at l.150; t1=visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence(md,[],1); t2=visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence(md,[],1); t2 has 5 columns and R1's heatmap colour is FFf6a077. Reach: the l.150 error needs a custom setColours (second argument) whose last fraction is above some reaction's fraction (recognisable: calls passing a scheme without a final 0 row); the re-run and lower-case defects depend on the folder's content, so every call reaches them; src/ callers: none (grep -w over src/ finds only the file itself). Coverage: quarantine layout, all 54 executable lines exempt (the parallel pool is not opened).
confirmed_by: lead (review T027; read l.141-152: setColours{i+1,1} indexes past the last row when no row matches, so a custom scheme without a 0 row errors; writer's MATLAB reproduction)

notes: independent review T027/T028: the reviewer's unrecorded one-line-reaction hang confirmed by reading only (not run in MATLAB, as instructed: l.245 sets line_ed from the same line, the while at l.255 is skipped, no fgets in the reaction branch outside that loop, so the outer while at l.149 repeats the line forever).
